result.description: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for quiet office dashboards, writing, and photo review. The NovaStream 27QX uses a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, 75Hz refresh rate, and a low-blue-light mode for all-day workspaces. It includes DisplayPort, HDMI, and a USB-C input with 65W power delivery, plus a simple height-adjustable stand and thin bezels for multi-monitor setups.
